items.title: How could Israel break election deadlock? Here are four scenarios

sentences.en: Here are four scenarios.

sentences.zh: 85%的选票被计入，所有迹象都指向僵局。

sentences.en: The most likely outcome may be new elections.

items.title: Egypt fines prominent editor Lina Attalah and shuts independent news outlet Mada Masr

sentences.en: Egypt fines prominent editor Lina Attalah and shuts independent news outlet Mada Masr.
sentences.zh: 埃及对知名编辑Lina Attalah处以罚款，并关闭了独立新闻媒体Mada Masr。

sentences.en: Warnings of escalating clampdown on press freedom come after Cairo court convicts Attalah of managing an unlicensed website Lina Attalah, a prominent Egyptian journalist and the editor-in-chief of the news outlet Mada Masr, has been released from detention by Egypt’s authorities and had her website ordered to be shut down by a court amid an intensifying crackdown on independent media in the country.
sentences.zh: 在开罗法院判定阿塔拉因管理一个未经许可的网站而被定罪后，新闻自由不断升级。阿塔拉是一位著名的埃及记者，也是新闻媒体Mada Masr的主编。她已被埃及当局释放，并在该国对独立媒体的镇压加剧的情况下，法院下令关闭她的网站。

sentences.en: Attalah was taken briefly into custody after a Cairo court convicted her of managing an unlicensed website, prompting fresh international concerns over press freedom in Egypt.
sentences.zh: 阿塔拉在开罗法院判定她管理一个未经许可的网站后被短暂拘留，引发了国际社会对埃及新闻自由的新担忧。

items.title: What's gone up even faster than gas or rent? The cost of caregiving

sentences.en: What's gone up even faster than gas or rent?
sentences.zh: 还有什么比汽油或租金上涨得更快的吗？

sentences.en: The cost of caregiving.
sentences.zh: 看护的成本。

sentences.en: A new study from AARP shows caregivers' out-of-pocket costs rose about 60% in the last five years.
sentences.zh: 美国退休人员协会（ AARP ）的一项新研究表明，在过去五年中，看护者的自付费用增加了约60 ％。

items.title: ‘Don’t be stinky’: recruitment a ‘huge issue’ facing Aukus submarine program

sentences.en: ‘Don’t be stinky’: recruitment a ‘huge issue’ facing Aukus submarine program.
sentences.zh: “不要发臭” ：招募Aukus潜艇项目面临的“重大问题”。

sentences.en: As USS Colorado showcases the program in Perth, retired admiral Peter Briggs says personnel is one of the ‘huge issues’ it faces Follow our Australia politics live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia faces an uphill battle to recruit and train enough naval personnel to serve on submarines planned for the future fleet of nuclear-powered vessels under the controversial $368bn Aukus deal , a retired admiral has warned.
sentences.zh: 随着科罗拉多号航母在珀斯展示该计划，退役海军上将彼得·布里格斯（ Peter Briggs ）表示，人员是其面临的“重大问题”之一。关注我们的澳大利亚政治直播博客，了解最新动态。一位退役海军上将警告说，我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客澳大利亚面临着一场艰苦的战斗，即招募和培训足够的海军人员，以便在有争议的奥库斯（ Aukus ） $ 3680亿美元协议下为未来核动力船队计划的潜艇上服役。

sentences.en: As the Virginia-class submarine USS Colorado arrived at HMAS Stirling south of Perth on Tuesday for a month of routine maintenance and to help build Australian expertise, retired admiral Peter Briggs said more people needed to be enrolled in the navy’s submarine program.
sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚级潜艇科罗拉多号于周二抵达珀斯以南的HMAS Stirling进行为期一个月的例行维护并帮助建立澳大利亚专业知识，退役海军上将彼得·布里格斯（ Peter Briggs ）表示，需要更多人参加海军的潜艇计划。

items.title: Record heat-related deaths in 2023, WHO-partnered report finds

sentences.en: Record heat-related deaths in 2023, WHO-partnered report finds.
sentences.zh: 世卫组织的合作报告发现， 2023年与高温相关的死亡人数创下纪录。

sentences.en: Climate inaction continues to harm and kill people in all countries with a record 710,000 estimated deaths globally from heat in 2023, a UN-partnered report warned on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 联合国的一份报告周三警告说，气候不作为继续伤害和杀害所有国家的人民， 2023年全球估计有创纪录的71万人死于高温。

sentences.en: For the first time, more than seven in 10 fatalities were attributable to human-caused climate change.
sentences.zh: 有史以来第一次，十分之七以上的死亡可归因于人为造成的气候变化。

items.title: DR Congo: WHO urges sustained efforts as Ebola cases top 10,000

sentences.en: DR Congo: WHO urges sustained efforts as Ebola cases top 10,000.
sentences.zh: 刚果民主共和国：世卫组织敦促持续努力，因为埃博拉病例超过1万例。

sentences.en: As Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) surpass the 10,000 mark, the World Health Organization (WHO) has underlined the need for continued efforts to contain spread of the disease.
sentences.zh: 随着刚果民主共和国（ DRC ）的埃博拉病例超过1万例，世界卫生组织（ WHO ）强调需要继续努力遏制该疾病的传播。

items.title: Protecting the storytellers: Women journalists on the frontline of conflict

sentences.en: Protecting the storytellers: Women journalists on the frontline of conflict.
sentences.zh: 保护故事讲述者：冲突前线的女性记者。

sentences.en: As online abuse, gender-based attacks and impunity ramp up the threats to women reporting from crisis zones, journalists and UN leaders are calling for urgent action to protect those who document conflict.
sentences.zh: 随着网络虐待、基于性别的攻击和有罪不罚现象加剧了对危机地区妇女报道的威胁，记者和联合国领导人呼吁采取紧急行动，保护那些记录冲突的人。

items.title: Ending conflict is ‘number one thing’ to reduce world hunger, new WFP chief says

sentences.en: Ending conflict is ‘number one thing’ to reduce world hunger, new WFP chief says.
sentences.zh: 世界粮食计划署新任署长表示，结束冲突是减少世界饥饿的“首要任务”。

sentences.en: Reducing conflict is the single most effective way to tackle global hunger, the new head of the UN World Food Programme (WFP), Luke Lindberg, said on Wednesday, noting that conflict drives two thirds of the acute food insecurity affecting 266 million people worldwide.
sentences.zh: 联合国世界粮食计划署（粮食计划署）新任负责人卢克·林德伯格（ Luke Lindberg ）周三表示，减少冲突是解决全球饥饿问题最有效的方法，并指出冲突造成了影响全球2.66亿人的严重粮食不安全的三分之二。

items.title: Backing for UN call to end Cuba embargo falls to 20-year low

sentences.en: Backing for UN call to end Cuba embargo falls to 20-year low.
sentences.zh: 支持联合国呼吁终止对古巴禁运的人数降至20年来的最低点。

sentences.en: The UN General Assembly on Wednesday called for the 34th time for an end to the US economic, commercial and financial embargo on Cuba – but with the weakest backing for the resolution in two decades.
sentences.zh: 联合国大会周三第34次呼吁终止美国对古巴的经济、商业和金融封锁，但对该决议的支持是二十年来最弱的。

items.title: UN human rights chief urges better protection of civilians in conflicts

sentences.en: UN human rights chief urges better protection of civilians in conflicts.
sentences.zh: 联合国人权事务主管敦促在冲突中更好地保护平民。

sentences.en: Youth-led protests against corruption and inequality in Serbia, Bangladesh, Nepal and Madagascar reflect a growing demand for reinforcing human rights around the world, UN human rights chief Volker Türk said at a press briefing on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 联合国人权事务主管沃尔克·蒂尔克（ Volker Türk ）周三在新闻发布会上表示，青年领导的反对塞尔维亚、孟加拉国、尼泊尔和马达加斯加腐败和不平等的抗议活动反映了世界各地对加强人权的日益增长的需求。

items.title: Civilians in Sudan’s El Obeid trapped between drones and incarceration

sentences.en: Civilians in Sudan’s El Obeid trapped between drones and incarceration.
sentences.zh: 苏丹奥贝德的平民被困在无人机和监禁之间。

sentences.en: Civilians in Sudan’s El Obeid live in constant fear of drone attacks by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) and of a wave of arbitrary arrests by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), UN-appointed independent investigators said on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 联合国任命的独立调查人员周三表示，苏丹奥贝德的平民一直担心快速支援部队（ RSF ）的无人机袭击和苏丹武装部队（ SAF ）的任意逮捕浪潮。

sentences.en: Higher Ground: How New York is raising a park to hold back the sea.
sentences.zh: 高地：纽约如何建立一个公园来阻挡大海。

sentences.en: On 29 October 2012, Hurricane Sandy slammed into New York City, unleashing a devastating storm surge that flooded homes, subways and tunnels, knocked out power and sparked deadly fires.
sentences.zh: 2012年10月29日，飓风桑迪袭击了纽约市，引发了毁灭性的风暴潮，淹没了房屋、地铁和隧道，断电并引发了致命的火灾。

items.title: A US woman feared dead was reported alive in Mexico. But police now say that isn’t true

sentences.en: A US woman feared dead was reported alive in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 据报道，一名美国妇女害怕在墨西哥活着死亡。

sentences.en: But police now say that isn’t true.
sentences.zh: 但警方现在说这不是真的。

sentences.en: Mexican police had said they found Shayna Feinman in Tijuana, raising the hopes of missing Arizonan’s family Arizona authorities say their Mexican counterparts were resoundingly mistaken when they publicly claimed recently that they found alive a woman who was feared slain after disappearing in 2024 – a turn of events that her sister has called “turmoil” and “heartbreaking”.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥警方曾表示，他们在提华纳找到了Shayna Feinman ，这让亚利桑那州当局表示，他们的墨西哥同行最近公开宣称，他们发现了一名在2024年失踪后被害身亡的女性，这是一个令人心碎的事件，她的妹妹称之为“动荡”和“心碎”。

sentences.en: The case in question centers on Shayna Feinman, who was reported missing in rural Yavapai county, Arizona, in March 2024 at age 38.
sentences.zh: 该病例以Shayna Feinman为中心，她于2024年3月在亚利桑那州Yavapai县农村失踪，时年38岁。

items.title: Africa’s ‘unprecedented’ Ebola outbreak could reach UK, says top health official

sentences.en: Africa’s ‘unprecedented’ Ebola outbreak could reach UK, says top health official.
sentences.zh: 高级卫生官员表示，非洲“史无前例”的埃博拉疫情可能会到达英国。

sentences.en: Jean Kaseya, of the Africa CDC, warns of the illness spreading like Covid unless more funding is secured to increase preparedness and possible treatment The “unprecedented” spread of the Ebola outbreak means it could reach the UK and other countries, according to one of Africa’s top health officials.
sentences.zh: 非洲疾控中心的让·卡塞亚（ Jean Kaseya ）警告说，除非获得更多资金来加强准备和可能的治疗，否则这种疾病将像新冠肺炎一样蔓延。据非洲一位高级卫生官员称，埃博拉疫情的“前所未有”蔓延意味着它可能会蔓延到英国和其他国家。

sentences.en: As the current outbreak reached 10,000 cases, with almost 5,000 deaths , Dr Jean Kaseya, director general of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), compared the outbreak to the Covid pandemic, which first took hold in China before spreading to countries across the world, claiming millions of lives, and ravaging health systems and economies.
sentences.zh: 随着目前的疫情达到10,000例，近5,000人死亡，非洲疾病控制和预防中心（ CDC ）总干事Jean Kaseya博士将疫情与新冠肺炎疫情进行了比较，新冠肺炎疫情首先在中国扎根，然后蔓延到世界各国，夺去了数百万人的生命，并蹂躏了卫生系统和经济。
